_comment: Baseline LLM call counts for the regression suite. Each number is the MAXIMUM allowed chatCompletion calls for the given scenario. Phase A work should reduce these; bumps up require explicit user approval in review. Regenerate with: npm test -- llm-budget.spec.ts -- --update-baseline (TODO: implement flag).

daily-briefing.en.fresh.description: English briefing, no cache. Deterministic — must never hit LLM.

daily-briefing.hi.fresh.description: Hindi briefing, no cache. A1b flipped both the global panchang/planet fields and the user-overlay greeting/quality/insight/summary/transit to KB lookups (KbService backed by KbPlanet, KbNakshatra, KbTithi, KbYoga, KbVara, KbPaksha, KbProfessionInsight, KbBriefingPhrase). translateFields removed from daily-briefing.service.ts — budget is now an absolute zero, not a soft one.

daily-briefing.en.cached.description: English briefing with warm cache. Must be zero.
